SELECT t.transaction_id, t.type, t.amount, t.memo, t.occurred_at, c.category_id, c.name AS category_name, e.emotion_id, e.name AS emotion_name, e.color AS emotion_color, t.goal_id, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN emotions e ON t.emotion_id = e.emotion_id
ORDER BY t.occurred_at ASC, t.transaction_id ASC ORDER BY c.name ASC, t.occurred_at DESC ORDER BY c.name DESC, t.occurred_at DESC ORDER BY t.amount ASC, t.occurred_at DESC ORDER BY t.amount DESC, t.occurred_at DESC ORDER BY t.occurred_at DESC, t.transaction_id DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'INCOME' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncome, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'EXPENSE' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpense FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, emotion_id, category_id, type, amount, memo, occurred_at, goal_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{emotionId}, #{categoryId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{memo}, #{occurredAt}, #{goalId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT t.transaction_id, t.type, t.amount, t.memo, t.occurred_at, c.category_id, c.name AS category_name, e.emotion_id, e.name AS emotion_name, e.color AS emotion_color, t.goal_id, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN emotions e ON t.emotion_id = e.emotion_id WHERE t.transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND t.user_id = #{userId}

mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET emotion_id = #{emotionId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, type = #{type}, amount = #{amount}, memo = #{memo}, occurred_at = #{occurredAt}, goal_id = #{goalId}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' ORDER BY occurred_at ASC
SELECT category_id FROM categories WHERE name = #{name} AND type = #{type} LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM occurred_at) BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 'DAWN' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM occurred_at) BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'MORNING' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM occurred_at) BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'AFTERNOON' ELSE 'NIGHT' END AS timeSlot, emotion_id AS emotionId, category_id AS categoryId, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(amount) AS totalAmount FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND emotion_id IS NOT NULL AND category_id IS NOT NULL AND amount > 0 GROUP BY timeSlot, emotionId, categoryId ORDER BY count DESC, totalAmount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT t.transaction_id, t.type, t.amount, t.memo, t.occurred_at, c.category_id, c.name AS category_name, e.emotion_id, e.name AS emotion_name, e.color AS emotion_color, t.goal_id, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN emotions e ON t.emotion_id = e.emotion_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' AND t.emotion_id = #{emotionId} AND t.category_id = #{categoryId} AND ( CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.occurred_at) BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 'DAWN' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.occurred_at) BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'MORNING' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.occurred_at) BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'AFTERNOON' ELSE 'NIGHT' END ) = #{timeSlot} ORDER BY t.occurred_at DESC
